title: 同步調相機
summary: 以旋轉慣量、勵磁及短路支援串連 12 個技術單元；新增 24 步，包含原理、假想算例、量測設計、失效辨識與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units connect rotating inertia, excitation and fault support through 24 new tasks with principles, hypothetical calculations, measurement design, failure discrimination and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的離線工程教育與報告判讀。數值為自行設定的教學假設，非產品保證、現場整定、製造配方或帶電操作程序；高壓、旋轉與大型設備實務由合格團隊依正式規格驗證。完成課程不是專業執照。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education and report interpretation from public principles. Inputs are independently chosen teaching assumptions, not product guarantees, field settings, recipes or live-work procedures. Qualified teams validate high-voltage, rotating and large equipment under formal requirements. Course completion is not professional licensure.

stages.title: 需求與能力
stages.description: 以三個技術單元完成「需求與能力」的模型及判讀，共六項獨立保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Three technical units develop needs and capability through six separately saved modeling and interpretation tasks.

steps.title: 無軸功輸入：模型與設計
steps.titleEn: No shaft-power input: model and design
steps.objective: 針對「無軸功輸入」建立可重算、可檢查的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a reproducible, reviewable engineering record for no shaft-power input.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，標出「無軸功輸入」的輸入、輸出及量測基準，再在學徒工作台排列對應元件或資料流。調相機從電網吸收功率補償損失。 在離線草圖或試算表建立基準與擾動兩種情境，寫出因果預測；用「畫有功及無功分離的能流圖。」規劃如何反駁模型。把未知參數、單位與邊界記錄在學習筆記。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor diagram, identify inputs, outputs and references for no shaft-power input, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. A condenser draws grid power to cover losses. Build baseline and perturbed cases offline and predict causality. Plan a falsification using: Draw separate active and reactive flows. Record unknown parameters, units and boundaries in your learning notes.
steps.observation: 畫有功及無功分離的能流圖。
steps.observationEn: Draw separate active and reactive flows.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「無軸功輸入」的驗證。 應先核對量測基準、模型邊界及競爭失效原因。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping no shaft-power input verification. Check references, model boundaries and competing failure causes first.
steps.check: 提交「無軸功輸入」的兩情境模型、單位表及可反駁預測；說明「畫有功及無功分離的能流圖。」如何區分情境。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case model, units and a falsifiable prediction for no shaft-power input; explain how the proposed check distinguishes cases.

knowledge.title: 本單元機制
knowledge.text: 調相機從電網吸收功率補償損失。
knowledge.textEn: A condenser draws grid power to cover losses.

knowledge.title: 可區分原因的證據
knowledge.text: 畫有功及無功分離的能流圖。 必須保留基準、單位及不確定度，未有實測資料時只做假想案例判讀。
knowledge.textEn: Draw separate active and reactive flows. Retain references, units and uncertainty; without measured data, interpret hypothetical cases only.

knowledge.title: 本課量化連結
knowledge.text: 假設慣性常數 H=4 s、額定 S=100 MVA，轉動能量 E=HS=400 MJ。若頻率從 50 降到 49 Hz 且轉速同比變化，可釋能 400[1−(49/50)²]=15.84 MJ；未含控制及損失。
knowledge.textEn: Assume inertia constant H=4 s and rating S=100 MVA: rotating energy E=HS=400 MJ. A proportional speed drop from 50 to 49 Hz releases 400[1−(49/50)²]=15.84 MJ, before controls and losses.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「同步調相機」的「無軸功輸入：模型與設計」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出能源來源、導體、負載、回流與保護的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「配電夜班：熱點追蹤」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與隔離低壓模型的接線圖、電流方向、測點與時間戳的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “No shaft-power input: model and design” in “Synchronous condensers”. Draw the source, conductor, load, return and protection boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Distribution Night Shift: Follow the Hotspot” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for isolated low-voltage wiring diagram, current direction, measurement points and timestamps, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

options: 調相機從電網吸收功率補償損失。

只調整「無軸功輸入」的顯示結果吻合，便可當作獨立量測證據。
optionsEn: A condenser draws grid power to cover losses.
Equal nominal ratings justify skipping no shaft-power input verification.
Tuning the displayed no shaft-power input result to match counts as independent measurement evidence.
quiz.explanation: 調相機從電網吸收功率補償損失。 畫有功及無功分離的能流圖。
quiz.explanationEn: A condenser draws grid power to cover losses. Draw separate active and reactive flows.

steps.title: 無軸功輸入：量測與判讀

steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit model and inspect two hypothetical cases without accessing energized equipment. Draw separate active and reactive flows. Compare the result against: A condenser draws grid power to cover losses. List at least two competing causes and select an additional discriminating measurement. Define acceptance from project requirements before observing results, include uncertainty and retain unverified items as unresolved.

steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement comparison, error sources and accept/hold rationale for no shaft-power input; do not hide limiting conditions behind one average.
